verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence documents no retention settings, deletion workflows, or purge APIs. Related evidence is adjacent only and earns no credit: targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook (data minimization), and self-hosting or warehouse-native querying means data stays on infrastructure the customer controls. Neither is a product control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
